metrics.speaker_tagged_metric_definition: minimum chronological Levenshtein on (word, speaker) pairs over global known-speaker permutations; word/speaker mismatch costs one substitution; unknown/overlap never match a reference person
metrics.metric_definition: minimum concatenated per-speaker Levenshtein errors with global permutation of known IDs, plus unknown/overlap words as an unmapped insertion stream; reference omissions remain deletions
